startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: The page the crawler starts from. Same-domain links found on it (and on the pages it discovers) are enqueued too, up to the crawl limit.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration used for every request. The only way to crawl direct with no proxy is an explicit `{"useApifyProxy": false}` -- omitting this field entirely is NOT equivalent; it falls through to the SDK's default proxy configuration (same as `useApifyProxy: true`) and requires a valid APIFY_PROXY_PASSWORD.
